record.bible_text: But now thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> that created<WH01254><WTH8802> thee, O Jacob<WH03290>, and he that formed<WH03335><WTH8802> thee, O Israel<WH03478>, Fear<WH03372><WTH8799> not: for I have redeemed<WH01350><WTH8804> thee, I have called<WH07121><WTH8804> <FI>thee<Fi> by thy name<WH08034>; thou <FI>art<Fi> mine.

When thou passest through<WH05674><WTH8799> the waters<WH04325>, I <FI>will be<Fi> with thee; and through the rivers<WH05104>, they shall not overflow<WH07857><WTH8799> thee: when thou walkest<WH03212><WTH8799> through<WH01119> the fire<WH0784>, thou shalt not be burned<WH03554><WTH8735>; neither shall the flame<WH03852> kindle<WH01197><WTH8799> upon thee.

For I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, the Holy One<WH06918> of Israel<WH03478>, thy Saviour<WH03467><WTH8688>: I gave<WH05414><WTH8804> Egypt<WH04714> <FI>for<Fi> thy ransom<WH03724>, Ethiopia<WH03568> and Seba<WH05434> for thee.

Since thou wast precious<WH03365><WTH8804> in my sight<WH05869>, thou hast been honourable<WH03513><WTH8738>, and I have loved<WH0157><WTH8804> thee: therefore will I give<WH05414><WTH8799> men<WH0120> for thee, and people<WH03816> for thy life<WH05315>. <RF>life: or, person<Rf>
Fear<WH03372><WTH8799> not: for I <FI>am<Fi> with thee: I will bring<WH0935><WTH8686> thy seed<WH02233> from the east<WH04217>, and gather<WH06908><WTH8762> thee from the west<WH04628>;

I will say<WH0559><WTH8799> to the north<WH06828>, Give up<WH05414><WTH8798>; and to the south<WH08486>, Keep not back<WH03607><WTH8799>: bring<WH0935><WTH8685> my sons<WH01121> from far<WH07350>, and my daughters<WH01323> from the ends<WH07097> of the earth<WH0776>;

<FI> Even<Fi> every one<WH03605> that is called<WH07121><WTH8737> by my name<WH08034>: for I have created<WH01254><WTH8804> him for my glory<WH03519>, I have formed<WH03335><WTH8804> him; yea, I have made<WH06213><WTH8804> him.<CM>
Bring forth<WH03318><WTH8685> the blind<WH05787> people<WH05971> that have<WH03426> eyes<WH05869>, and the deaf<WH02795> that have ears<WH0241>.

Let all the nations<WH01471> be gathered<WH06908><WTH8738> together<WH03162>, and let the people<WH03816> be assembled<WH0622><WTH8735>: who among them can declare<WH05046><WTH8686> this, and shew<WH08085><WTH8686> us former things<WH07223>? let them bring forth<WH05414><WTH8799> their witnesses<WH05707>, that they may be justified<WH06663><WTH8799>: or let them hear<WH08085><WTH8799>, and say<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>It is<Fi> truth<WH0571>.

Ye <FI>are<Fi> my witnesses<WH05707>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, and my servant<WH05650> whom I have chosen<WH0977><WTH8804>: that ye may know<WH03045><WTH8799> and believe<WH0539><WTH8686> me, and understand<WH0995><WTH8799> that I <FI> am<Fi> he: before<WH06440> me there was no God<WH0410> formed<WH03335><WTH8738>, neither shall there be after<WH0310> me. <RF>no...: or, nothing formed of God<Rf>
I, <FI>even<Fi> I, <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>; and beside<WH01107> me <FI>there is<Fi> no saviour<WH03467><WTH8688>.

I have declared<WH05046><WTH8689>, and have saved<WH03467><WTH8689>, and I have shewed<WH08085><WTH8689>, when <FI>there was<Fi> no strange<WH02114><WTH8801> <FI>god<Fi> among you: therefore ye <FI>are<Fi>  my witnesses<WH05707>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, that I <FI>am<Fi> God<WH0410>.

Yea, before the day<WH03117> <FI>was<Fi> I <FI>am<Fi> he; and <FI>there is<Fi> none that can deliver<WH05337><WTH8688> out of my hand<WH03027>: I will work<WH06466><WTH8799>, and who shall let<WH07725><WTH8686> it? <RF>let it: Heb. turn it back?<Rf><CM>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, your redeemer<WH01350><WTH8802>, the Holy One<WH06918> of Israel<WH03478>; For your sake I have sent<WH07971><WTH8765> to Babylon<WH0894>, and have brought down<WH03381><WTH8689> all their nobles<WH01281>, and the Chaldeans<WH03778>, whose cry<WH07440> <FI>is<Fi> in the ships<WH0591>. <RF>nobles: Heb. bars<Rf>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, which maketh<WH05414><WTH8802> a way<WH01870> in the sea<WH03220>, and a path<WH05410> in the mighty<WH05794> waters<WH04325>;

Which bringeth forth<WH03318><WTH8688> the chariot<WH07393> and horse<WH05483>, the army<WH02428> and the power<WH05808>; they shall lie down<WH07901><WTH8799> together<WH03162>, they shall not rise<WH06965><WTH8799>: they are extinct<WH01846><WTH8804>, they are quenched<WH03518><WTH8804> as tow<WH06594>.
Remember<WH02142><WTH8799> ye not the former things<WH07223>, neither consider<WH0995><WTH8709> the things of old<WH06931>.

Behold, I will do<WH06213><WTH8802> a new thing<WH02319>; now it shall spring forth<WH06779><WTH8799>; shall ye not know<WH03045><WTH8799> it? I will even make<WH07760><WTH8799> a way<WH01870> in the wilderness<WH04057>, <FI>and<Fi> rivers<WH05104> in the desert<WH03452>.

The beast<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> shall honour<WH03513><WTH8762> me, the dragons<WH08577> and the owls<WH01323><WH03284>: because I give<WH05414><WTH8804> waters<WH04325> in the wilderness<WH04057>, <FI>and<Fi> rivers<WH05104> in the desert<WH03452>, to give drink<WH08248><WTH8687> to my people<WH05971>, my chosen<WH0972>. <RF>owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl<Rf>
This<WH02098> people<WH05971> have I formed<WH03335><WTH8804> for myself; they shall shew forth<WH05608><WTH8762> my praise<WH08416>.<CM>
But thou hast not called<WH07121><WTH8804> upon me, O Jacob<WH03290>; but thou hast been weary<WH03021><WTH8804> of me, O Israel<WH03478>.

Thou hast not brought<WH0935><WTH8689> me the small cattle<WH07716> of thy burnt offerings<WH05930>; neither hast thou honoured<WH03513><WTH8765> me with thy sacrifices<WH02077>. I have not caused thee to serve<WH05647><WTH8689> with an offering<WH04503>, nor wearied<WH03021><WTH8689> thee with incense<WH03828>. <RF>small...: Heb. lambs, or, kids<Rf>

Thou hast bought<WH07069><WTH8804> me no sweet cane<WH07070> with money<WH03701>, neither hast thou filled<WH07301><WTH8689> me with the fat<WH02459> of thy sacrifices<WH02077>: but thou hast made me to serve<WH05647><WTH8689> with thy sins<WH02403>, thou hast wearied<WH03021><WTH8689> me with thine iniquities<WH05771>. <RF>filled...: Heb. made me drunk, or, abundantly moistened<Rf>
I, <FI>even<Fi> I, <FI>am<Fi> he that blotteth out<WH04229><WTH8802> thy transgressions<WH06588> for mine own sake, and will not remember<WH02142><WTH8799> thy sins<WH02403>.
Put me in remembrance<WH02142><WTH8685>: let us plead<WH08199><WTH8735> together<WH03162>: declare<WH05608><WTH8761> thou, that thou mayest be justified<WH06663><WTH8799>.
Thy first<WH07223> father<WH01> hath sinned<WH02398><WTH8804>, and thy teachers<WH03887><WTH8688> have transgressed<WH06586><WTH8804> against me. <RF>teachers: Heb. interpreters<Rf>

Therefore I have profaned<WH02490><WTH8762> the princes<WH08269> of the sanctuary<WH06944>, and have given<WH05414><WTH8799> Jacob<WH03290> to the curse<WH02764>, and Israel<WH03478> to reproaches<WH01421>. <RF>princes...: or, holy princes<Rf><CM>
